name: docker_container_status
description: Queries the local Docker daemon and reports container status, healthcheck state, uptime, restart count, published ports and live resource statistics including CPU percentage, real memory usage, network and block I/O, and PID count. Read-only: never starts, stops or removes containers.

container.description: Name or ID of a single container to inspect. Omit to report all containers.

all_containers.description: Include stopped containers as well as running ones

include_stats.description: Collect CPU, memory, network and I/O statistics for running containers

limit.description: Maximum number of containers to report (1-200)
